propositions: Prevent ticket close when plan or upstream pinned dependencies changed during execution without blocking all closes for code file changes during normal implementation.

Implement a close-time plan-review gate that runs plan validity checks (signature, reopen, registry, phase compatibility, own-material, configured pin enforcement) while intentionally excluding code freshness checks.
Add a generic pre_status_check callback to txn.transition_core that executes inside the existing write lock immediately before STATUS append, enabling close policy enforcement without double-locking.

Return exact validity verdicts (unsigned, stale-reopened, stale-regver, stale-material, unverifiable-material, stale-pin-drift, stale-pin-missing, malformed-pin, incompatible-phase, malformed-phase, unavailable) and fail-closed on unexpected exceptions without model/network calls.
Preserve existing close exemptions (bugs, session logs, code reviews, identities, idea→closed) and force-close bypass behavior while ensuring child-closure rules are never bypassed.
Default require_plan_review_for_close to false to preserve byte-for-byte equivalence of existing close paths when enforcement is disabled.
